CustomField.description: The API value of the Gift Transaction Status that means paid in this org. Written on each Gift Transaction the mirror creates, and the only Status a Gift Transaction may have to become a gift. Empty, or not an active Status value, means nothing is mirrored.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Status your paid Gift Transactions have, exactly as its API name, for example Paid. Until it is set, nothing is mirrored.
CustomField.label: Gift Transaction Mirror Status
